dataset_spec.name: ppd_bangladesh
dataset_spec.description: Bangladesh postpartum depression screening (800 women). Binary EPDS high-risk from sociodemographic, obstetric, and neonatal history.
dataset_spec.setting: Woman in Bangladesh surveyed within about two years of giving birth (Raisa and Kaiser 2024 postpartum survey). The observations are her sociodemographic and family circumstances, relationships and support, obstetric and newborn history, and two-item depression screens (PHQ-2) recalled for the periods before and during the latest pregnancy; her current mood and sleep questions are withheld.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Sociodemographic, family, obstetric and newborn history:
